source_claim: The official Tales Channel+ title page identifies Tales of Rebirth, provides that game's character roster, and lists ヴェイグ・リュングベル (Veigue Lungberg) and アニー・バース (Annie Barrs). Those two names map exactly to current canonical Character tags in the residual campaign and are explicitly members of this game's roster. The page lists the title itself as Tales of Rebirth, supporting its in-catalog title Copyright as their HOME.
notes: The remaining roster names were excluded unless an exact corresponding current campaign tag was present on the page. No broad Tales-series HOME is inferred; the evidence is scoped to the title-specific Tales of Rebirth root.
